map.因为按字节截断时切在了多字节字符中间：UTF-8 下一个汉字占 3 字节，从中间: Because byte-based truncation cuts in the middle of a multi-byte character: under UTF-8 a Chinese char is 3 bytes, and cutting in the middle yields an undecodable byte sequence shown as a question mark or box. map.：按码点计数与截断，不会切在代理对中间产生半个 emoji；组合字符（肤色、ZW: : counts and truncates by code point, so it never cuts inside a surrogate pair to produce a half emoji; combining characters (skin tones, ZWJ sequences) may still be split by code point.
map.截断模式分四种：按字符数按码点（Array.from）计数，省略符占用长度上限—: There are four truncation modes: character mode counts by code point (Array.from) and the ellipsis counts toward the length limit — the ellipsis's code-point count is subtracted from limit first, then the body is cut; with word-boundary enabled, the cut point walks back from the retained end to the nearest whitespace, falling back to the reduced limit if none is found; word mode splits on whitespace into words, keeps the first limit words and joins them with spaces; line mode splits on newlines, keeps the first limit lines and joins them with newlines; byte mode sums the actual UTF-8 bytes of each code point (1 byte for ASCII, 2 for the 2-byte range, 3 for the 3-byte range, 4 for supplementary planes), subtracting the ellipsis's byte count from the limit first, and stops when the sum would exceed it. With truncate-from-end enabled it keeps the corresponding number of characters, words or lines from the end instead. When truncation happens and an ellipsis is set, the ellipsis goes in front for end-truncation and at the end otherwise. With per-line processing enabled and a mode other than line mode, the text is split on newlines first and each line is truncated separately.
